svg.aria-label: GA-40 · board layout (derived) — redrawn board layout diagram
svg.text: Redrawn from Gibson factory drawing, title block "GA-40" with the "Les Paul" signature at the lower left — layout DERIVED from that circuit drawing; Gibson published no board-layout sheet for this chassis and none was located — not a trace
Note: the 6.3 V heater twisted pair always routes on the top layer and never joins another run — its crossings are not hop-overs.
